summary: 用连词把两个句子连起来，表示时间、条件、原因、结果等关系。重点：时间（when/while/as soon as）和条件（if/unless）从句中，用一般现在时表将来。

rules.title: 时间状语从句：when / while / as soon as / before / after / until
rules.detail: 「主将从现」：主句用将来时，时间从句用一般现在时。as soon as 表示「一……就……」；not...until 表示「直到……才……」。

examples.en: I will call you as soon as I get there.
examples.zh: 我一到那儿就给你打电话。

examples.en: He didn't go to bed until his mother came back.
examples.zh: 直到妈妈回来他才睡觉。

examples.en: When the bus stops, we can get off.
examples.zh: 等公交车停下，我们就可以下车。

rules.title: 条件状语从句：if / unless
rules.detail: if 表示「如果」；unless = if not 表示「除非」。同样遵守「主将从现」：从句用一般现在时，主句用 will / be going to。

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
examples.zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里。

examples.en: You will fail the exam unless you work hard.
examples.zh: 除非你努力学习，否则考试会不及格。

rules.title: 原因 / 结果 / 让步
rules.detail: because（因为）so（所以）不能同时用在一个句子里；so...that 表示「如此……以至于」；although/though（虽然）but（但是）也不能同时用。

examples.en: He was so tired that he fell asleep at once.
examples.zh: 他太累了，立刻就睡着了。

examples.en: Although it was raining, we still went out.
examples.zh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是出去了。

pitfalls: 主将从现用错：❌ If it will rain, I won't go. → ✓ If it rains, I won't go.
because 和 so 连用：❌ Because he was ill, so he stayed home. → 两者只用一个
until 肯定否定弄反：not...until = 直到……才

questions.stem: I will wait ___ you come back.
questions.explain: 「我会一直等到你回来」用 until。

questions.stem: If it ___ sunny tomorrow, we ___ to the park.
questions.explain: 主将从现：条件从句用一般现在时 is，主句用将来时 will go。

questions.stem: He was ___ excited ___ he couldn't sleep.
questions.explain: so + 形容词 + that 从句，表示「如此……以至于」。

questions.stem: ___ he is very young, he knows a lot about science.
questions.explain: 前后是让步关系（虽然年轻但懂得多），用 although；不能再加 but。

questions.stem: I'll tell him the news as soon as he ___ (come) back.
questions.explain: 主将从现：as soon as 从句中用一般现在时 comes（he 三单）。

questions.stem: ___ (如果) you don't hurry, you will miss the bus.
questions.explain: 「如果」用 if 引导条件状语从句。

questions.stem: Because he was tired, so he went to bed early.
questions.explain: because 和 so 不能在同一个句子里连用，英语只保留一个。

questions.stem: 除非你早点出发，否则你会赶不上火车。（翻译整句）
answer: you will miss the train unless you start early.
unless you start early, you will miss the train.
questions.explain: unless = if not；主句用将来时 will miss。

questions.stem: 当他长大后，他想成为一名科学家。（翻译整句）
answer: he wants to be a scientist when he grows up.
when he grows up, he wants to be a scientist.
questions.explain: 主将从现：when 从句用 grows up（三单），主句 wants 用一般现在时（表意愿亦可用 will）。
